SELECT sv.tenant_id,sv.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,s.classification, sv.rights_revision,sv.original_sha256,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND v.version_id=sv.source_version WHERE sv.source_version=#{id}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_upload_result cu JOIN customer_connector_item ci ON ci.tenant_id=cu.tenant_id AND ci.project_id=cu.project_id AND ci.upload_id=cu.upload_id WHERE cu.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND cu.source_version=sv.source_version AND ci.state='REVOKED' )

SELECT r.tenant_id,r.rights_revision,r.source_version,r.purpose,r.allowed_actions,r.providers,r.regions,r.valid_from,r.valid_to, r.status,r.evidence_manifest,r.content_sha256,r.schema_version,r.schema_manifest_sha256,r.classification, v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id FROM rights_revision r JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.version_id=r.rights_revision WHERE r.rights_revision=#{id}

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.project_id,m.snapshot_id,m.source_id,m.source_version,m.parse_version,m.index_version,m.approval_revision, m.binding_revision,p.parse_status,i.status AS index_status,i.expected_count,i.verified_count, g.approval_revision AS current_approval_revision,g.upload_status,g.approval_status,g.lifecycle,g.revision AS gate_revision, a.decision,a.reviewed_manifest_sha256,b.applicability,j.status AS project_status FROM scope_member m JOIN scope_snapshot ss ON ss.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND ss.project_id=m.project_id AND ss.snapshot_id=m.snapshot_id JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND p.source_version=m.source_version AND p.parse_version=m.parse_version JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND i.source_version=m.source_version AND i.parse_version=m.parse_version AND i.index_version=m.index_version JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND g.source_version=m.source_version AND g.parse_version=m.parse_version JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND a.source_version=m.source_version AND a.parse_version=m.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=m.approval_revision JOIN project_source_binding b ON b.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND b.project_id=m.project_id AND b.source_version=m.source_version AND b.binding_revision=m.binding_revision JOIN project j ON j.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND j.project_id=m.project_id WHERE m.source_version=#{id} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND m.parse_version=#{parseVersion} ORDER BY m.parse_version
SELECT parse_version,upload_status,approval_status,lifecycle,revision FROM source_use_gate g WHERE source_version=#{id} ORDER BY parse_version
mapper.sql: SELECT p.tenant_id,b.project_id,NULL AS snapshot_id,sv.source_id,p.source_version,p.parse_version,i.index_version, a.approval_revision,b.binding_revision,p.parse_status,i.status AS index_status,i.expected_count,i.verified_count, g.approval_revision AS current_approval_revision,g.upload_status,g.approval_status,g.lifecycle,g.revision AS gate_revision, a.decision,a.reviewed_manifest_sha256,b.applicability,j.status AS project_status FROM parse_version p JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=p.source_version JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.source_version=p.source_version AND i.parse_version=p.parse_version JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.source_version=p.source_version AND g.parse_version=p.parse_version JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND a.source_version=g.source_version AND a.parse_version=g.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=g.approval_revision JOIN project_source_binding b ON b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND b.source_version=p.source_version AND b.is_current=TRUE JOIN project j ON j.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND j.project_id=b.project_id

SELECT tenant_id,collection_version,source_version,parse_version FROM collection_member cm WHERE collection_version=#{id} ORDER BY source_version,parse_version LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.tenant_id,c.project_id,c.conversation_id,b.source_id,c.owner_id,c.status,c.classification,c.revision FROM source_session_binding b JOIN conversation c ON c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.project_id=b.project_id AND c.conversation_id=b.session_id WHERE c.conversation_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.source_id
SELECT consumer_version_id,upstream_version_id,relation_kind FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{id} ORDER BY upstream_version_id,relation_kind
